verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page line saying you can 'Build AI‑powered audiences from a complete customer view,' which suggests some AI-assisted capability over customer data inside Segment. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced in the product, and the Profile API recommendation engine is something users build themselves, not a product feature. Missing for 10: documentation of in-product AI insights or suggestions, details of how the AI-powered audiences feature works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
